_about: Numbers of the experiments that finished after the round-50 test tables (appendix of the report: Flow-DiT variants, the goal overlay and its overlay-off check, the near-miss share on the final-test pool). Typed in from the named reports; paper_numbers.py writes each entry as one macro of numbers.tex. 'signed' values are paired changes in points and are written as +x or $-$x. Seeds 15000000 + 20*i (200 per shape) are the pool of the final test; seeds 400000 + 20*i (50 per shape) are the selection (validation) scenes.
